thread:
Jordan Patel: Heads-up — Novus Retail reported an incoming wire that was returned by the correspondent bank.
Jordan Patel: Bank's note: "Invalid IBAN: country code must be upper-case" and return code R04 (invalid account). Customer says they copied IBAN from invoice PDF.
payments-bot: Automated: return_receipt pmt_01HkZ2 -> status: returned, reason_code: IBAN_INVALID, note: "country code lowercase / non-normalized" :warning:
Jordan Patel: Attached snippet from our payment API request (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/payments
{
  "beneficiary_name": "Novus Retail",
  "iban": "gb29nwbk60161331926819",
  "amount": 15000,
  "currency": "GBP"
}
```
Marco Ruiz: Looks like the IBAN was submitted with a lowercase country code and no normalization. Swift rails expect uppercase country code + mod97 check.
Alice Chen: Quick repro on staging: submitted same body -> bank simulator returns IBAN_INVALID with note about country code case. Repro steps: 1) paste lowercase IBAN 2) submit via payments API 3) see return.
Priya Singh: Customer also had spaces and a trailing hash on their invoice (weird OCR). We should defensively sanitize incoming account fields from UI/imports.
Marco Ruiz: Short-term fix: update server-side normalization + validation before submission. Example: 
```python
iban = iban.replace(' ', '').replace('-', '').upper()
if not validate_iban_mod97(iban):
    raise ValueError('invalid iban')
```
Also add a metric for payments rejected by rails for IBAN format.
Alice Chen: Can ops re-run the payment after normalization, or must customer re-initiate? Bank says returns are final, we need to reissue a new payment with corrected details.
ops-oncall: We can reissue from our console if customer confirms authorization. Need idempotency note: create new payment record, set original as returned, mark refund/credit workflow.
Jordan Patel: Customer asked if this was on our side vs their invoice. I replied it's likely their invoice OCR/copy sanitized to lowercase. Suggest we offer to re-submit once we normalize and they confirm.
Priya Singh: Longer-term: add validation on invoice ingestion, highlight account formatting issues to customers at upload time (flag: "IBAN looks lowercase/has spaces"). Also add link to docs: how to copy IBANs correctly.
Marco Ruiz: I've opened ENG ticket ENG-1248 to add normalization middleware + preflight check and to instrument rails rejection reasons. ETA EOD tomorrow for a patch behind feature flag.
Alice Chen: For immediate triage: Jordan, please confirm with Novus (1) approve reissue (2) confirm beneficiary details. I'll prepare ops runbook.
Jordan Patel: Confirmed — Novus approved reissue after we normalize. Sending them a one-time correction + new payment id. :thumbsup:
payments-bot: Action logged: ops-reissue requested by Jordan P for pmt_01HkZ2 -> new attempt pmt_01HkZ2-2, queued.
ops-oncall: Reissue completed, bank accepted submission. Will monitor for settlement. Closing thread after settlement or if bank returns again.
Jordan Patel: Thanks all. Filing customer note and refund workflow steps. :white_check_mark:
